description: This file is a CMake module script used to find and configure the Weston compositor library within a build system. It checks for the presence of Weston and sets a variable indicating whether Weston was found.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: CMake command to locate a package, in this case PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: CMake macro to check for the presence of a package using pkg-config, here checking for Weston version 6 or higher.
